content: मासिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [मासे भवः ठञ्] .²1 Relating to a month. .²2 Happening every month, monthly. .²3 Lasting for a month. .²4 Payable in a month. .²5 Engaged for a month. .{@-कम्@} A funeral rite or Śrāddha performed every newmoon (during the first year of a manʼs death); पितॄणां मासिकं श्राद्धमन्वाहार्यं विदुर्बुधाः; मासिकान्नं तु योऽश्नीयात् <ls>Ms. 11. 157</ls>.
